summary: Phase 1 (bootstrap, Build, leaf): 5 steps — scaffold Vite+React+TS+Vitest; controlled vocab types; zod schema validation; CSV→JSON converter with cuisine consolidation + ref classification; seed fixture end-to-end proof. Regime: Build (all steps objectively verifiable). No escalation triggers. Decisions: D-12 (zod for validation), D-13 (seed fixture branch coverage). Git initialized from scratch; initial commit made.

Phase 1 acceptance suite: 4 test files under tests/acceptance/phase_1/ — test_vocabularies.test.ts (10 tests: vocabulary completeness and structural invariants), test_schema_validation.test.ts (15 tests: valid shapes and all rejection cases for unknown values/missing fields), test_csv_converter.test.ts (25 tests: field splitting, balance_scores JSON parsing, cookMinutes omission, IngredientRef classification, all error conditions, cuisine consolidation sampling), test_seed_fixture.test.ts (8 tests: end-to-end proof on 14-ingredient seed.csv covering all 8 cooking stages). Red as expected — no src/ or scripts/ implementation exists yet. Fixture uses only GroupTag refs to be self-consistent.

Scaffolded Vite+React+TS app: package.json (react 18, zod, vitest, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react), tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts with vitest node env, index.html, src/main.tsx. node_modules symlinked from /tmp/bas/node_modules (NTFS workspace — binaries need Linux fs). All 4 acceptance test files discovered by vitest, failing on missing src/types, src/schema, scripts/convert-catalog as expected.

Implemented src/types.ts: 8 const vocabulary arrays (COOKING_STAGES, INGREDIENT_CATEGORIES, ROLES, BALANCE_AXES, TRAITS, CUISINE_TAGS, SALT_RISKS, GROUP_TAGS), GROUP_DEFINITIONS record (category or ids per tag), derived union types, and Ingredient interface. All 10 test_vocabularies acceptance tests pass.

Implemented src/schema.ts: zod ingredientSchema with enum validation for all 8 controlled vocabularies (stage, category, roles, traits, balanceScores axes, cuisines, saltRisk), optional fields (cookMinutes, pairsWith, avoidWith, cuisineWeights, notes). All 19 schema validation acceptance tests pass.

Implemented scripts/convert-catalog.ts: RFC 4180 CSV parser, semicolon-delimited field splitting, balance_scores JSON parsing, cookMinutes omission when blank, cuisine consolidation map (16 aliases to canonical CuisineTag values), IngredientRef classification as GroupTag or IngredientId with unresolved-ref error, vocabulary drift errors for all 6 controlled vocabularies, namespace collision guard (ID vs GroupTag), and duplicate ID detection. All 34 csv_converter acceptance tests and 9 seed_fixture tests pass (72 total phase 1 tests green).

Verified end-to-end catalog integrity proof: seed.csv fixture covers all 8 cooking stages (brown, aromatics, deglaze, pressure, simmer_after, stir_in, finish, serve_over) across 14 ingredients. All 9 test_seed_fixture acceptance tests pass, all 72 phase-1 tests green. Converter → schema validation pipeline confirmed working on the seed fixture.

Phase 1 review: 1 Must (beans group used category:legumes instead of explicit 4-ID contract list), 2 Should (herbs IDs missing mint/chives/oregano; lentils IDs mismatched architecture) all applied. 1 Optional skipped (D-14: vinegar group ID names deferred to Phase 2 catalog reconciliation). All 72 tests pass after fixes. Acceptance suite integrity confirmed: no diff against TESTS commit.

Phase 1 closed: 72 tests pass (4 acceptance files); no contract propagation (phase has no dependencies); 2 gotchas promoted (group-name/category mismatch, NTFS node_modules symlink); D-12, D-13, D-14 already closed; ARCHITECTURE.md Phase 1 row -> Complete.

Phase 2 (Catalog and Build Core, Build, Pattern B, leaf): 5 steps. (2,1) run full CSV conversion + add convert:catalog script; (2,2) catalog loader with load-time integrity validation; (2,3) immutable build operations with typed UnknownIngredientError; (2,4) React build store (context+useReducer); (2,5) minimal stage-grouped build summary UI proving end-to-end catalog->build->UI flow. D-15: build reducer takes catalog as parameter for clean unit testing. No escalation triggers fired.

Phase 2 acceptance suite: 4 files, 35 contract tests under tests/acceptance/phase_2/ covering catalog integrity (full load >=100 ingredients, no dupes, disjoint namespaces, all pair/avoid refs resolve, group membership), catalog access API (getIngredient, listIngredients with stage+category filters, determinism, mutation isolation), immutable build operations (addIngredient/removeIngredient/moveIngredient/updateBuildIngredient all return new builds, UnknownIngredientError on unknown IDs, duplicate prevention, multi-ingredient coexistence), and stage-grouped summary (groupBuildByStage canonical order, empty stages omitted, all ingredients in exactly one group). Red as expected: src/catalog.ts, src/build.ts, StewBuild type not yet implemented.

Ran full CSV catalog conversion on insta_the_pot_ingredients_v2.csv (119 ingredients). Added convert:catalog npm script (vite-node scripts/run-catalog-conversion.ts). Generated src/ingredients.json as build output. All 119 rows convert cleanly through vocabulary validation, balance_scores JSON parse, cuisine consolidation, and pairsWith/avoidWith ref classification.
Added strict Zod parsing for the generated ingredient catalog and kept load-time cross-reference validation after parse. Catalog-focused phase 2 tests remain green.
Implemented immutable build operations and stage grouping in src/build.ts with typed unknown-ingredient errors and canonical stage buckets.
Added a React build store with BuildStoreProvider, useBuildStore, and a reducer-backed in-memory catalog/build state.
Rendered a minimal stage-grouped build summary UI with a seeded demo build, plus a server-render regression test for canonical stage order and empty-state handling.

Review halted: phase-2 build code in src/types.ts and src/build.ts diverges from ARCHITECTURE.md. The implemented StewBuild shape only preserves id and ingredients, while the architecture defines additional build fields that mutation helpers should retain. Needs contract reconciliation before close.

Supervised-session fix resolving the phase-2 audit_escalation: StewBuild now declares name/servings/pressureMinutes/naturalReleaseMinutes/liquidAmount/notes, and cloneBuild spreads the whole build so add/remove/move/update retain all contract fields; added a field-retention test in tests/acceptance/phase_2/test_build_operations.test.ts. Tests deferred to the Pi re-review (no node_modules on the NTFS share). State reset to review.

Review halted: src/build.ts removeIngredient still silently no-ops for unknown IDs, but ARCHITECTURE.md says unknown ingredient IDs produce a typed error for the build mutation API. This is contract drift and needs reconciliation before close.

Second supervised-session fix for phase-2 contract drift (iter 19): removeIngredient now throws UnknownIngredientError when the id is not in the build, matching updateBuildIngredient/moveIngredient and the ARCHITECTURE Build Mutation guarantee (unknown ids produce a typed error); updated the contradicting test. Full audit of build.ts (all four mutations) and catalog.ts (deep-copy returns, deterministic listIngredients) done - no further drift. State reset to review.

Phase 2 review: 0 Must, 1 Should (CatalogFilter used `string` for stage/category instead of typed CookingStage/IngredientCategory — fixed) applied. 2 Optionals skipped: D-16 (assertValidStage redundant runtime check), D-17 (deep-copy strategy inconsistency). Acceptance suite intact (no diff from TESTS commit). All 115 tests pass after fix.
Phase 2 closed: 115 tests pass; ARCHITECTURE.md implementation-sequence row -> Complete; 2 gotchas promoted from contract drift and metadata-retention fixes; no decision updates required.

Phase 3 (Interactive Composer, Build): 7 steps — app shell, Library tabs+cards, Library search, Detail panel+stage picker, Stage Timeline, keyboard accessibility, Analysis placeholder+acceptance test. No dep probe needed (leaf for UI purposes; build store is already wired). D-21 records Analysis-column deferral to Phase 4. Pattern B confirmed — no module field.

Phase 3 acceptance suite: 4 files, 37 contract tests under tests/acceptance/phase_3/ covering (1) four-column layout and Analysis placeholder presence; (2) Library category tabs filter by category, name search composes with active tab, cards are compact; (3) Detail panel opens on click, shows full metadata, stage picker has all 8 stages, placement places/moves ingredient, Escape closes; (4) Timeline canonical stage order, placed ingredients appear correctly, move updates stage, remove removes, multi-ingredient coexistence; (5) keyboard accessibility — Tab reaches Library cards and category tabs, Enter/Space activate stage-picker and remove buttons. All tests red as expected: jsdom, @testing-library/react, and @testing-library/user-event are not installed; UI components do not exist yet.
Built the Phase 3 app shell with a header banner and four ordered composer regions: Library, Detail, Cooking Timeline, and Analysis placeholder.

Three attempts to make timeline removal keyboard-activatable in jsdom failed: button keydown/keyup handlers, then list-level key delegation. The Phase 3 salt-risk assertion also collides with the Chicken thighs heading via /low|medium|high/.

HUMAN STEER resolving the iter-25 audit_escalation on step 3.2. Both blockers are ACCEPTANCE-TEST bugs, NOT app logic. Do NOT add manual key handlers to components. (1) src/components/BuildSummary.tsx: revert the iter-25 anti-pattern — delete handleStageListKeyDown and the onKeyDownCapture on the stage-lane-list div; the remove control is already a native <button data-ingredient-id> and is keyboard-activatable by default. (2) tests/acceptance/phase_3/test_keyboard_a11y.test.tsx: the two remove tests fail because the 30-iteration Tab scan never reaches the timeline remove button (the Library renders many focusable items first). Replace the scan with a direct query: within(timeline).getByRole(button, name:/remove/i), call .focus(), then user.keyboard({Enter}) and user.keyboard({Space}) respectively — user-event fires a click on Enter/Space for a focused native button. (3) tests/acceptance/phase_3/test_detail_and_placement.test.tsx ~line 103: /low|medium|high/ also matches the high inside Chicken thighs, so queryByText throws on multiple matches. Scope the query to the salt-risk element (e.g. a testid or a Salt risk: label) or word-boundary anchor, and use a real assertion (toBeInTheDocument), not toBeDefined. Correcting these buggy acceptance tests is IN SCOPE for this step. State reset to execute to redo 3.2.

Kept the Library column green and fixed two bad phase 3 assertions: the salt-risk query now targets the exact dd value, and the timeline remove test now focuses the chicken remove button directly before keyboard activation.
Verified the Library name search already composes with the active category tab filter; phase 3.3 acceptance tests passed without code changes.
Verified and closed the Detail panel + stage picker step; full Phase 3 acceptance suite passed (50 tests green).
Verified the Stage Timeline column renders the canonical eight-stage lane list, stage-grouped ingredient rows, and remove interactions; phase 3 acceptance remained green.
Removed the container-level keyboard fallback from the timeline summary so remove actions rely on the native buttons. Phase 3 keyboard and placement acceptance tests still pass.
Promoted the analysis lane from a generic teaser to a static Phase 3 placeholder with ingredient and populated-stage counts plus the Phase 4 note. Phase 3 acceptance suite passed.

Phase 3 review: 1 Must (getDisplayIngredients first-word deduplication in IngredientLibrary hid catalog variants — removed), 2 Should (describeRoles showed count string instead of actual names — fixed; notes showed 'Catalog note available.' placeholder — fixed with actual content), 1 Optional skipped (D-24). Acceptance test changes from 3.2 human steer documented as D-22. Must+Should fixes cascaded into 14 test-query robustness fixes (queryByText → queryAllByText/getAllByText) documented as D-23. All 165 tests green after fixes.
Phase 3 closed: 50/50 acceptance tests pass; 2 gotchas promoted; ARCHITECTURE.md phase 3 row -> Complete. No contract propagation changes required.

Phase 4 (Analysis and Guidance, Build, Pattern B): 9 steps. Step 1 adds AnalysisResult/AnalysisMessage/TimingFinding/IngredientSuggestion types and the analyzeBuild skeleton. Steps 2-7 build the analysis sub-systems in isolation (balance, cuisine, pairings, timing, stage warnings, composition warnings). Step 8 creates 10 representative fixture builds and validates the combined engine against expected outputs — this is the cross-product test. Step 9 wires live analysis into the Analysis column UI. Decisions D-25 (types location + provisional thresholds), D-26 (pure module contract), D-27 (fixture strategy). No dep probe needed: pattern B, no inter-module contracts.

Phase 4 acceptance suite: 3 test files, 43 contract tests under tests/acceptance/phase_4/. test_analysis_engine.test.ts covers the analyzeBuild signature, result shape, purity, balance score accumulation, cuisine scoring (universal exclusion), warning/finding shape, and non-mutation guarantees. test_analysis_rules.test.ts covers each MVP rule in isolation: miso/spinach/couscous stage placement warnings, per-ingredient timing findings (over/under/within/no-cookMinutes), pairing synergy observability, avoidance cautions (direct ID + group tag), symmetric deduplication, and all five composition rules. test_analysis_fixtures.test.ts covers 10 documented representative builds (heavy beef/french, bright chicken-lemon-spinach, bean+tomato, root+starch stack, french-affinity, mexican-affinity, east-asian/miso, salt stack, no-greens, timing mismatch) with exact balance totals and cuisine scores pinned to catalog data. Red as expected — src/analysis.ts not yet implemented.

Added analysis result types and a deterministic analyzeBuild engine with balance, cuisine, stage, timing, pairing, avoidance, and composition signals. Aligned garlic catalog timing data with the phase 4 contract.
Balance axis scoring is already implemented via additive accumulation across all BALANCE_AXES and passes the phase 4 analysis suite.

Added weighted cuisine affinity scoring in analyzeBuild, excluding universal contributions and honoring per-ingredient cuisineWeights. Added a focused unit test and verified phase 4 analysis suites pass.
Normalized pairing and avoidance warnings to a canonical ingredient order and added a regression test for order-insensitive pair/avoid signals.
Validated timing findings against the phase 4 analysis suite; pressure-only under/overcook detection passes all fixture and rule tests.
Stage placement warnings already satisfied the phase 4 contract; verified the acceptance suite and recorded the step as complete.
Composition warnings and gap suggestions already met the phase 4 contract; verified the analysis suite remains green and recorded the step as complete.
Validated the ten representative analysis fixture builds and confirmed the full phase 4 acceptance suite passes (67 tests).
Wired the Analysis column to analyzeBuild with rendered balance, cuisine, warning, suggestion, and timing sections; added a focused panel test.

Phase 4 review: 1 Must (replaceAll requires ES2021 lib — broke tsc in build pipeline; upgraded tsconfig target/lib to ES2021 and added explicit string type to capitalize regex callback), 2 Should (removed unused imports SALT_RISKS and BuildIngredient from analysis.ts) applied. 1 Optional skipped (D-28: formatCount helper in AnalysisPanel). Acceptance suite intact (no diff vs frozen TESTS commit). 236 tests pass, tsc --noEmit clean.
Phase 4 closed: full test suite passed; ARCHITECTURE.md implementation sequence row updated to Complete; 1 gotcha promoted (ES2021 replaceAll).

Phase 5 (Instructions and Persistence, Build, Pattern B): 6 steps. Step 1: generateInstructions pure function + GeneratedRecipe type. Step 2: persistence adapter (localStorage CRUD + schemaVersion JSON export/import with validation). Step 3: pressureMinutes/naturalReleaseMinutes UI controls. Step 4: instructions panel in BuildSummary with copy button. Step 5: saved builds UI (save/restore/delete/import/export). Step 6: E2E test (chicken-roots-barley-spinach-lemon, save/reload, verify instructions+warnings). No dependency probe needed (Pattern B, single-document). Decision D-29 records step ordering rationale.

Phase 5 acceptance suite: 3 files under tests/acceptance/phase_5/ — test_instructions_contract.test.ts (14 tests: GeneratedRecipe shape, canonical stage order, empty-stage omission, quantity handling, text content, purity/non-mutation), test_persistence_contract.test.ts (16 tests: schemaVersion in export, import round-trip, malformed JSON rejection, unknown ingredient ID error listing, save/load/list/delete localStorage contract), test_e2e_chicken_stew.test.ts (12 tests: chicken-roots-barley-spinach-lemon build assembly, analysis, instruction generation, export-import round-trip, instruction determinism after round-trip). Red as expected — src/instructions.ts and src/persistence.ts do not exist yet.
Added deterministic generateInstructions with canonical stage ordering, quantity-aware ingredient lines, stage timing text, and ingredient notes support.
Implemented persistence adapter with schemaVersion export/import, localStorage CRUD, and unknown-ingredient validation.
Added cook timing inputs to BuildSummary, threaded build-level updates through the store, and verified the phase 3 timeline suite plus phase 5 tests and TypeScript compile.

Added a generated instructions panel to BuildSummary with canonical stage steps and empty-build messaging; covered it with unit tests and verified the phase 5 suite plus TypeScript and production build.
Added a Saved Builds panel with header save, restore, delete, rename, export, and import flows, plus event-driven refresh and component coverage.
Verified the chicken/roots/barley/spinach/lemon end-to-end acceptance suite and closed the last phase 5 step.

Phase 5 review: 1 Must (instructions panel inside BuildSummary/timeline section duplicated stage names and ingredient names, breaking 13 phase 3 acceptance tests — extracted to InstructionsPanel component rendered outside the timeline section), 2 Should (formatSavedAt identity function removed, deepClone wrapper inlined to structuredClone), 1 Optional skipped (D-30: updateFeedback inline). 290 tests pass, tsc clean.

Phase 5 closed: 290 tests pass; tsc and Vite build pass when invoked through node; ARCHITECTURE.md implementation-sequence row -> Complete. No contract propagation changes; no decision updates required.
